messages.author: c0ac1a2ca1463b3a
messages.subject: Call reactivePlot after reactivePrint completes
parts:
Suppose I have two outputs on a page, print and plot.  The plot depends on parameters from print, so it must be called after print completes.  I'm not sure how to do this.   Both functions are called by an action button.  I tried introducing a global variable but couldn't get it to work.      

Example:

  output$CALC1 <- reactivePrint(function() {
    if(input$action1!=0){
      return(isolate({
          ### do some stuff
          invisible()

      }))
    }else{return(NULL)}
  })

  output$Plot1 <- reactivePlot(function() {
    if(input$action1!=0){
      return(isolate({

          ### Plot after CALC1 has completed!

          invisible()

      }))
    }else{return(NULL)}
  })

messages.subject: Re: Call reactivePlot after reactivePrint completes
parts:
I think you should be able to make it work by simply modifying output$Plot1 to take a dependency on output$CALC1.

For example:

  output$Plot1 <- reactivePlot(function() {
    if(input$action1!=0){
      # Make this reactivePlot dependent on CALC1
      # even though the returned value isn't used for anything
      output$CALC1

return(isolate({

          ### Plot after CALC1 has completed!

          invisible()

      }))
    }else{return(NULL)}
  })

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Call reactivePlot after reactivePrint completes
parts:
Actually I don't think "output$CALC1" will do anything. You can't read from output objects, only assign to them.

I'd extract the calculation to be a separate function (and then you can change reactivePrint to reactiveText, because we're doing the capture.output in calc, which is really the only difference between the two):

calc <- reactive(function() {
  paste(capture.output({
    if (input$action1 != 0) {
      isolate({
        # calculate
        invisible()
      })
    }
    else
      invisible()
  }), collapse="\n")
})

output$CALC1 <- reactiveText(function() {
  return(calc())
})

output$Plot1 <- reactivePlot(function() {
  calc()  # take a dependency
  isolate({
    # plot
  })
})
